author: Eddie Makuch
description:
2026 is the 25th anniversary of Xbox, and it's been a tough year for the brand with mass layoffs, studio closures/divestitures, and game cancellations. But the celebrations are still going ahead, including an event from the Xbox-owned Candy Crush mobile game juggernaut.

Announced today, Candy Crush Saga is marking the Xbox anniversary with a "Game On" season that brings items and elements from Halo, Fallout, Sea of Thieves, Forza, Doom, Banjo-Kazooie, Crash Bandicoot, and Spyro into the game through a virtual pin-collection event. Additionally, the popular and recognizable music from some of those games is coming to Candy Crush in "unmistakable Candy style," developer King said.
title: Candy Crush Is Celebrating Xbox’s 25th Anniversary With Halo, Fallout, And Doom Crossovers, Including Remixed Music

author: Ben Janca
description: From its dizzying development history to its extensive gameplay mechanics, here’s everything to know about Grand Theft Auto VI.
title: Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) Everything To Know

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has announced that id Software is officially working on a new game, believed to be another Doom title. This is happening after Sharma oversaw id Software losing half of its staff to layoffs that were part of the Xbox "reset."

Id Software replied to Sharma's post on Twitter to provide a few more details on the new game, which the team didn't say was a Doom game, but ev
title: New Doom Game Seemingly Announced In The Weirdest Way After Half The Studio Was Laid Off

author: Chris Pereira
description:
Like the other console makers (not to mention every other company mimicking Spotify), Xbox typically releases a personal annualized recap, letting you look back on what that year entailed for you. With this month marking the 25th anniversary of Xbox as a brand, the company has delivered a supersized version of that feature, the Playback Archive, letting you see your full Xbox history over that span. It should be a fun, celebratory thing. Instead, I find it depressing.

This has been a rough year for Xbox. It's certainly not the first time that's been true in the company's history, but this is a whole different level of troubling (I yearn for the days when Kinect being mandatory was the biggest issue). 2026 for Xbox has seen
title: My Trip Down Xbox Memory Lane Should Be Celebratory, But Instead It’s Just Depressing

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
It's no secret that the market for physical video games is drying up, but don't expect physical media for gaming to go away entirely anytime soon, or ever, according to Take-Two's Strauss Zelnick.

He told The Game Business that it "may not be the end" for physical media entirely in games, even with Sony killing off PlayStation discs in 2028. He said there will "always be some physical business" for gaming, but it will be a "very small part of the business."
title: Games Will Have A Physical Footprint Forever, Take-Two Boss Says, But It’ll Be “Very Small”

author: Ben Janca
description:
Celebrate 25 years of XBOX with an exclusive look at brand new Fable Quest Gameplay. The Hero of Briar Hill has entered the depths of Deepwood alongside Arden, a local Hero, to investigate why strange magical happenings have been troubling the people of Oakshire. Here, they cross a threshold where the natural magic of Deepwood appears corrupted by an outside force, and they discover hints as to who or what could be responsible...

Fable launches on 23 February 2027 on XBOX Series X|S, Steam and PlayStation 5. You'll get up to 5 days Early Access with the Premium Edition which includes the Fable Digital Artbook & Soundtrack, the Fable: Order of the Hero expansion (coming post-launch) and the 'Premium Edition Content Pack’ which includes two cosmetic armour sets and in-game gifts.
title: Fable – 4 Minutes Of New Questing Gameplay

author: Chris Compendio
description:
On November 25, two entirely separate games called Piece by Piece are releasing on Nintendo Switch. It's no coincidence, but the circumstances that led to this unusual situation certainly stem from a coincidence.

Publisher No More Robots launched Piece by Piece, a cozy sim game full of cute animal characters, on Steam back in March. Two days later, studio Neon Polygons self-published an unrelated puzzle-platformer where you jump through literal puzzle pieces that you connect together--this game is also called Piece by Piece.

What could have been a conflict between indie developers turned out to be the beginning of a wholesome business relationship. Both games were bundled together on Steam, and now No More Robots is publishing the Switch ports of both titles.
title: This Happy Ending For Two Games With Identical Names Was A Headache For Nintendo

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
The Game Awards will air on Disney+ this year, and along with that, Disney has teased "major announcements and surprises" for its own games at the event. To be sure, The Game Awards will stream in other places, too, like YouTube and Twitch, so you won't need to sign up for Disney+ to watch.

"As the evening unfolds, viewers can expect major announcements and surprises from some of Disney’s most anticipated titles in gaming," the company said.

That's all that Disney had to say on the matter, but the tease has gotten people excited to theorize about the possibilities. For starters, Disney is already a big player in the world of video games, with
title: Disney Teases “Major Announcements” For The Game Awards

author: Steve Watts
description:
The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is largely a very reverent remake, with new quality-of-life features and small tweaks. That goes for the story as well, which largely maintains the original and slightly expands or clarifies some sections. But it also appears to pay homage to a classic Zelda manga.

The manga is The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time by Akira Himekawa, which itself was a retelling of the Nintendo 64 game. It was released in Japan in 2000 and first released in America in 2008, followed by an expanded Legendary Edition in 2016. This version of the story isn’t considered canon, as it took liberties here and there, but a couple of those have now been incorporated into the remake's story.
title: The Legend Of Zelda: Ocarina Of Time Remake Pays Tribute To A Classic, Non-Canon Manga

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
It's the 25th anniversary of Xbox, and to celebrate, you can see how much time you've spent--or wasted, according to my parents--playing games on Xbox hardware over the years. Not to be confused with the end-of-year wrap-up that Xbox usually offers, Xbox Playback looks at your entire history, from when you first booted up a console to your current-day Achievements.

It's a neat little celebratory feature, complete with a customized video and graphics that you can show off. In addition to the date you started playing on Xbox, it includes the first Xbox console you used, the first game you booted up, your total hours played, a breakdown of game genres, and more. (There are some limits on data during Xbox's early years, though.) You can try it out by signing in to your Xbox account through this link.
title: Xbox Has Spent 25 Years Tracking Your Gaming Habits; Now You Can See The Damage

author: Cameron Koch
description:
The Final Fantasy 14 community is in mourning following news that Eikichi Iwai, the bassist for the game's house band, The Primals, has died at the age of 57, and is taking to the MMORPG's main hub cities to honor his legacy.

An "Important Announcement" post on the official FF14 website from developer Square Enix on November 11 broke the news, and stated the development team was "deeply saddened" to inform the community of Iwai's passing.

"Having witnessed his truly unforgettable performance on stage at the recent Final Fantasy 14 Fan Festival in Japan, the sudden news of his passing has come as a profound shock," the statement reads. "The members of The Primals and the entire FF14 developmen
title: Final Fantasy 14 Players Are Mourning The Loss Of The Game’s Legendary Bassist

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
As Xbox celebrates its 25th anniversary, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has shared her thoughts on where gaming is going over the next 25 years, and people are saying her message is really more about pushing AI.

Sharma said modern games demonstrate the "heights of human craft in ways unimaginable just decades ago." However, the costs, resources, and risks that companies need to take on have "grown just as dramatically," she said.

"As a result, too many ideas never become games, and too many games fall short of what their creators imagined. For decades, this has been the unavoidable tradeoff of ambition. We must change this," she said.
title: Xbox CEO’s 25th Anniversary Message Is About AI, Even If She Won’t Say It

author: Cameron Koch
description:
The launch of a new MMORPG is a special occasion. It's not just the arrival of a new game, but, in many ways, the birth of a new world. 

World of Warcraft: Forever's launch was no different, and it seems like everybody was eager to get in on the ground floor. It was a remarkably smooth start for developer Blizzard's third major version of WoW, and even though Azeroth is a place players have seen before and many know like the back of their hand, there was an excitement in the air, a spring in everyone's step, and an eagerness to see what was around every corner.

This wasn't just a new WoW expansion, after all. This was the arrival of the new version of Azeroth millions of players will call home possibly for, well, forev
title: WoW: Forever Is For Everyone, And Launch Just Proved It

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
It's the end of an era for Nvidia, as its founder and longtime CEO, Jensen Huang, has resigned effective immediately. The face of one of the largest companies in the US and the growing AI boom, Huang's retirement comes after news broke of his two extramarital affairs, one of which was with a suspected Chinese spy.

Nvidia has appointed its Chief Financial Officer, Colette Kress, to serve as interim CEO and Harvey C. Jones as Chair of the Board, but Huang's departure will leave a void that won't be easily filled, as he was heavily involved in Nvidia's day-to-day operations.

The news is also expected to complicate things for Nvidia's stock price, as it has been in decline for over a month. The internet is already having
title: The Internet Reacts To Jensen Huang’s Resignation From Nvidia

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Nintendo has announced its 2026 Black Friday deals, with a Mario Kart World Switch 2 hardware bundle as the centerpiece for $500.

The Switch 2 launched in 2025 with a similar bundle for the same price, but it was discontinued at the end of the year. It later returned, but at a higher price point--$550. Now, the bundle is on "sale" again, though it's the same price as it was in 2025 before th
title: Mario Kart World Switch 2 Bundle Black Friday Deal Brings The Price Back To 2025 Levels

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 looks like it will have an impressive attention to detail, and that includes how one of the main characters, Jason, can drink a beer and eat a donut at the same time. Now that's living.

Rockstar boss Rob Nelson geeked out to The Guardian about GTA 6's finer details, including this one. According to the report, Jason can "take bites of a donut with one hand while sipping a beer
title: GTA 6’s Jason Can Live His Best Life By Drinking A Beer And Eating A Donut Simultaneously

author: Callum Self
description:
Grand Theft Auto VI is already eyed as a Game of the Year contender, and with pre-order sales in the millions, there are very few that can rival it. Except, of course, our favorite prince-beating, Fiona-loving ogre, Shrek. Remastering a cult classic based on the best Shrek movie, Shrek 2 Remastered is exactly what you’d expect, and with a launch discount, it’s enough to say, “That’ll do, Callum, that’ll do.”

I wouldn’t be surprised if GTA 6 pre-orders are hitting new lows after this, especially with Shrek 2 Remastered on sale, but this isn’t a joke—this is an absolute classic of a game, polished up for a new generation to fall in love with. It’s a blast with friends, delivering a co-op adventure that follows the events of one of the best animated movies of all time, and I do not say that lightly. Don’t joke about Shrek 2.
title: It’s Ogre For GTA 6, As Shrek 2 Remastered Gets A Huge Discount At Launch

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
After years of post-apocalyptic survival stories and archaeological adventures, Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet looks like a fresh opportunity for Naughty Dog to showcase a new sci-fi universe. Visually, the game draws on '80s sci-fi movies with analog technology and ancient hardware like CD players, but you can also thank a genre-defining anime film for shaping Intergalactic's look and feel.

In an interview with Patton Oswalt during the Comic Creators Block Party 2026, Naughty Dog director Neil Druckmann said that Akira inspired Intergalactic on multiple levels, alongside other big anime properties like
title: Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet Has Some Unexpected Anime Influences

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet developer Naughty Dog has been largely radio silent about its upcoming sci-fi game since it was first revealed in 2024, but it looks like 2027 will bring a lot more information.

Speaking to Patton Oswalt during the Comic Creators Block Party 2026, director Neil Druckmann teased that the game is entering its "final stage" of production. "We've only teased it, so I can't talk too much about it," Druckmann said. "But we're kind of like at the last stages of production, where we can play it, and we're refining and polishing it, and I can't wait to show it to the world."
title: Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet Is Entering Its Final Stage Of Development, With More To Come In 2027

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Amid multiple delays and radio silence, a rumor that Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra had been canceled began circulating this week. Developer Skydance quickly said the game is on track and nearly done—but it might not be what you expect.

According to Kotaku, executive producer Lu Gigliotti told Skydance employees that he had spoken with the studio's executive leadership team, and that the game had not been canceled. "They asked me to make sure you all hear that directly. There is no truth to these claims," Giglotti reportedly wrote in the Skydance Slack group. Kotaku added that the game is approaching its Alpha milestone and is "close to done," but after reportedly running significantly over budget, the vision for this project has been scaled back
title: Marvel 1943: Rise Of Hydra Isn’t Canceled, But Don’t Get Too Excited

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Things look dire for Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, as his future at the company may be in jeopardy. Recently, it was revealed that Huang had been involved in an extramarital affair with a suspected Chinese spy, and this week, news broke that he'd been involved in a second affair with one of his executives.

According to The New York Times, the Nvidia board of directors is meeting to discuss the situation, just days after launching an independent investigation into him. After the affair was first exposed, Nvidia quickly issued a statement saying that none of the company's secrets, or US state secrets, had been compromised. Huang also issued a letter to Nvidia employees, apologizing to his wife and children.<
title: Nvidia’s Board Is Weighing Jensen Huang’s Future After Second Affair Revelation
